messages.subject: Bug in pcountOpen
parts:
Hi everyone,

Sarah Frey found a bug in pcountOpen that causes problems when the covariates of gamma, omega, or iota vary among primary periods but not among sites. If you use this type of covariate, you should notice that your AIC values are extremely different (eg greater than an order of magnitude larger) than models without the covariate.

This issue will not arise if any of the gamma/omega/iota covariates in the model vary among sites. 

I will try to fix this as soon as I can, but in the meantime, do not rely on models in which the covariates vary among primary periods but not among sites. 

Richard
